units.text: And when the Lord your God brings you into the land whither you go to inherit it, and removes great nations from before you, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations numerous and mightier than you,
and the Lord your God delivers them into your hands, and you strike them, you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, neither shall you show them mercy.
Neither shall you intermarry with them; you shall not give your daughter unto his son, nor take his daughter for your son.
For he will turn your son away from Me, and he will serve other gods; and the Lord shall be kindled to wrath against you, and shall destroy you speedily.
But you shall do thus unto them: you shall pull down their altars, and break their pillars, and cut down their sacred groves, and burn the graven images of their gods with fire.
For you are a holy people unto the Lord your God; and the Lord your God has chosen you to be unto Him a people for His own possession, above all the nations upon the face of the earth.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:

And you shall speak unto the sons of Israel: If any of the sons of Israel, or of the resident foreigners who have joined Israel, gives any of his seed unto a ruler, let him surely be put to death; the nation upon the land shall stone him with stones.
And I will set My face against that man and destroy him from among his people, because he gave some of his seed to a ruler, defiling My holy things and profaning the name of those consecrated to Me.
But if the natives of the land utterly overlook that man with their eyes, when he gives any of his seed unto a ruler, so as not to put him to death,
then I will set My face against that man and his kin. I will destroy him from among their people, together with all who agree with him so that he prostitutes himself after rulers.
to put you far from a straight way and make you alien to a righteous judgment.
Son, do not let evil counsel seize you, counsel that abandons the teaching of youth and has forgotten a divine covenant.
For she has set her house beside death and her courses beside Hades with the earthborn.
All who travel in her will not return, nor will they reach straight paths, for they are not reached by years of life.
Pharisees came to Him, testing Him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any cause?”
He answered, “Have you not read that the Creator from the beginning made them male and female,
and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?
So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has yoked together, let no human being separate.”
They said to Him, “Why then did Moses command giving a certificate of divorce and divorcing her?”
He said to them, “Because of your hardness of heart Moses permitted you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except on account of sexual immorality, and marries another commits adultery.”
To the married I give this instruction—not I, but the Lord: a wife is not to separate from her husband—
but if she does separate, let her remain unmarried or be reconciled to her husband—and a husband is not to dismiss his wife.
Woe to those calling evil good and good evil, making darkness light and light darkness, making bitter sweet and sweet bitter!
Woe to those who are discerning in their own judgment and knowledgeable in their own view!
Woe to your strong ones who drink wine and the powerful who mix strong drink,
who justify the ungodly for gifts and take away the righteous person’s right!
Comfort, comfort My people, says God.
You priests, speak to the heart of Jerusalem; comfort her. For her humiliation is fulfilled, her sin is loosed; for from the hand of the Lord she has received double for her sins.
A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight the paths of our God.
Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be brought low; all the crooked places will become straight, and the rough country will become plains.
And the glory of the Lord will be seen, and all flesh will see the salvation of God; for the Lord has spoken.
As they went away, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to behold? A reed shaken by the wind?
But what did you go out to see? A man dressed in soft clothing? Behold, those wearing soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I send My messenger before Thy face, who will prepare Thy way before Thee.’
Truly I tell you, among those born of women none greater than John the Baptist has arisen; yet the least in the kingdom of the heavens is greater than he.
From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of the heavens suffers violence, and violent men seize it.
For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
And if you are willing to receive it, he is Elijah who is to come.
Let the one who has ears hear.
The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, Son of God.
As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Look, I send My messenger before Thy face, who will prepare Thy way;
a voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; make His paths straight.’”
John appeared, baptizing in the wilderness and proclaiming a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem were going out to him. They were being baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.
When John’s messengers had departed, He began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to behold? A reed shaken by the wind?
But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft garments? Behold, those who live in splendid clothing and luxury are in royal palaces.
But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I send My messenger before Thy face, who will prepare Thy way ahead of Thee.’
I tell you, among those born of women no one is greater than John; yet the lesser one in God’s kingdom is greater than he.”
Therefore thus says the Master, the Lord Sabaoth: “Woe, mighty ones of Israel! For My anger will not cease among My opponents, and I will exact judgment from My enemies.
I will bring My hand against you and burn you to purity. I will destroy the disobedient, remove all lawless people from you and humble all the arrogant.
I will establish your judges as before and your counselors as at the beginning. After these things you will be called City of Righteousness, Faithful Metropolis Zion.
For her captivity will be saved through judgment and through mercy.
Sword, awake against My shepherds, against the man who is My fellow citizen, says the Lord Almighty! Strike the shepherds and tear away the sheep; I will bring My hand against the shepherds.
Throughout the land, says the Lord, the two parts will be destroyed and fail, but the third will remain in it.

I will lead the third through fire, refine them with fire as silver is refined and test them as gold is tested. He will call on My name, and I will listen to him and say, ‘This is My people,’ and he will say, ‘The Lord is my God.’”
I have made you a tester among tested peoples, and you will know Me when I test their way.
All are unheeding, walking crookedly, bronze and iron; all are corrupted.
The bellows failed from the fire; the lead failed. In vain the silversmith works silver; their wickedness was not melted away.
Call them rejected silver, because the Lord rejected them.
For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would have given it; Thou wilt not delight in burnt offerings.
A sacrifice to God is a broken spirit; a broken and humbled heart God will not despise.
Do good to Zion, Lord, in Thy good pleasure, and let Jerusalem’s walls be built.
Then Thou wilt delight in a sacrifice of righteousness, an offering and burnt offerings; then they will bring calves upon Thine altar.
“I have hated and rejected your festivals, and I certainly will not smell a pleasing scent in your festal gatherings,
because even if you bring Me whole burnt offerings and your sacrifices, I will not receive them, and I will not look upon the salvation offering of your display.
Remove from Me the sound of your songs; I will not listen to the music of your instruments,
and judgment shall roll as water, and righteousness as an impassable torrent.
And Adam said: This, at last, is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. She shall be called Woman, for she was taken from her husband.
For this reason a man shall leave his father and his mother and cleave to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh.
Mountains shook before Him and hills were shaken; the whole earth recoiled before Him, and all who dwell in it.
Who will stand before His anger? Who will resist His furious wrath? His fury melts rulers, and rocks were crushed before Him.
